info.title: Converge API
info.description: Real-time collaborative editing API. Errors use { "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }.

post.summary: Create an account and sign in
Sign in with email and password
Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair (rotation)
Revoke a refresh token and every token rotated from it
Create a document (the caller becomes its owner)

get.summary: Documents the caller owns or is a member of, newest first

delete.summary: Delete a document (owner only; soft delete)

get.summary: List members, owner first. Emails are shown to the owner only.

post.summary: Add a member by email (owner only)
